title: Which server gets the next job?
hook: Which server gets the next job? Change one condition and inspect the result.

knows: that a toy model states its assumptions
doesNotKnow: send each job to the shorter of two random servers; the worst queue shrinks dramatically versus picking one at random.

misconception: Eight arrivals all choose server 0 first, paired in turn with servers 1,1,2,3,4,5,6,7. Starting empty, assign each to the shorter queue, choosing the second on a tie. What is the largest queue? The prediction alternatives contrast different consequences of the stated model.
objective: send each job to the shorter of two random servers; the worst queue shrinks dramatically versus picking one at random.

provenance.difference: New teaching boundary: Power of two choices. Existing boundary: The learner can explain that each step down in the power divides by 2, so 2⁰ = 2 ÷ 2 = 1, and the pattern continues to 1/2 and 1/4.
